research.organization: IEEE Computational Intelligence Society - LLM Task Force
research.title: Multi-Agent RAG for Enterprise Decision Workflows
research.desc: Researching and engineering an agentic Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for enterprise decision workflows. The system transforms RAG into a coordinated multi-agent architecture where specialized agents plan, route, retrieve, extract evidence, answer questions, aggregate outputs, synthesize responses, and verify final answers with confidence and evidence.
highlights: Architected an eight-agent RAG workflow spanning routing, planning, step definition, retrieval, evidence curation, grounded generation, summarization, and verification.

Implemented an end-to-end retrieval pipeline supporting PDF, TXT, and Markdown documents with chunking, embeddings, FAISS vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, contextual compression, and per-step confidence scoring.

Achieved a 100% pass rate across 8 knowledge-base regression cases and 14 automated tests by implementing evidence-sufficiency gating, post-answer verification, retries, self-correction, and structured fallback logic.
Integrated Ollama and Llama 3.2 3B for local planning, extraction, grounded question answering, summarization, and verification while retaining optional OpenAI overrides.

Established JSONL audit artifacts including an evidence ledger and A2A journal to capture agent actions, retrieved chunk identifiers, sufficiency decisions, intermediate responses, and verification outcomes.
